title: PLAID targets mid-January 2027 to resume KARTE after breach; data of ended-contract companies also affected
what_changed: Summary said 'some data of 570 to 754 customer companies', which read as one range; PLAID gives four non-additive categories (570, 487, up to 409, 754). Action no longer tells customers to rotate credentials, which the PLAID pages do not say.
